Subject: Resale bundles for observability channel partners — Datadog & Grafana proposal

Hi Jackie,

Great to meet at Observability Summit last month — appreciate the introduction from Sam. Observify's managed tracing product maps nicely to a lightweight agent we ship and we've been exploring a joint resale approach with Datadog and Grafana as channel bundles.

Short note on what we have in mind:
- A pre-packaged "observability bundle" that pairs Redwood-hosted inference telemetry (traces + model-level sampling) with Observify's tracing and Datadog/Grafana dashboards.
- One SKU for small customers (single-tenant bundle) and one for mid-market (multi-tenant, SLAs).
- Co-marketing credits and a joint onboarding playbook; revenue share for referrals + margin for resellers.

I've attached a one-pager and an initial pricing matrix for you to review. If you're open, would you and your GTM lead be available for a 30-minute call next week to go over how Observify would position the bundle to existing customers? Vanessa and Marcus from our partnerships and product teams are looped in.

Next steps we imagine: 1) quick commercial alignment, 2) draft reseller agreement, 3) pilot with 1-2 customers.

Thanks —

Tessa Morgan
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
